title: The Independence-at-Home Checklist Pack
tagline: Printable + laminate-friendly routines to help kids learn responsibility without constant reminders.
brand_top: Raising Capable Kids — Simple visual checklists for more independence at home
positioning: You don’t need an expensive system to raise independent kids. You need clear expectations, consistency, and visuals.

checklists.title: Bedroom Reset Checklist
checklists.subtitle: A simple room reset before the next part of the day.
items: Put pajamas or clothes in the basket
Put books and toys back where they belong
Check: Does my room feel ready?
checklists.gentle_note: Parent tip: Start with three items for younger children, then add the rest when the rhythm feels natural.

checklists.title: Bathroom Cleanup Checklist
checklists.subtitle: Small habits that make the bathroom peaceful for the next person.
items: Wipe the sink area if needed
Check: Is the bathroom ready for the next person?
checklists.gentle_note: Parent tip: Keep a small cloth within reach if wiping the sink is part of the routine.

checklists.title: After-Meal Checklist
checklists.subtitle: A calm routine for helping after snacks and meals.
items: Bring my plate, cup, and utensils to the sink
Wipe my spot at the table
Put lunchbox or snack items away
Check: Is my eating space clean?
checklists.gentle_note: Parent tip: Practice right after one meal each day before expecting it after every meal.

checklists.title: Living Room Reset
checklists.subtitle: A quick family-space reset so everyone can enjoy the room.
items: Put toys or activities in their basket
Look under the couch or table
Check: Is the room ready for the family?
checklists.gentle_note: Parent tip: Use one basket for items that need to return to other rooms after the reset.

checklists.title: Morning Routine Checklist
checklists.subtitle: A visual rhythm for beginning the day without repeated reminders.
items: Come to breakfast or morning time
checklists.gentle_note: Parent tip: Keep this checklist near the bedroom or bathroom, not hidden in a binder.

checklists.title: Bedtime Routine Checklist
checklists.subtitle: A gentle end-of-day rhythm children can learn to follow.
items: Get in bed for story, prayer, or goodnight
checklists.gentle_note: Parent tip: If evenings feel rushed, begin the checklist 15 minutes earlier for one week.
